description: Public Transit Services and Reduced-fare Programs by County Current Transportation is a dataset listed in Commonwealth of Pennsylvania open data portal (data.pa.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Commonwealth of Pennsylvania. This dataset lists all public transit services and reduced-fare programs currently provided in each county of PA. Coverage: Pennsylvania. The portal files it under the category Infrastructure and Development. Its tags are share, bus, transportation, transit, route. The table has 24 columns. Attribution on the portal: Pennsylvania Department of Transportation. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-pa-gov-portal.
